Grenade Launchers are a class of weapon introduced in Destiny 2. This weapon type can exist in two different forms, the breech-loaded single round grenade launcher, which can exist in the kinetic or energy slots, or the drum-loaded multi-round magazine grenade launcher, which exist solely in the power weapons slot. Similarly to rocket launchers, this type of weapon fires a single, heavy-hitting projectile that deals moderate area-of-effect damage. Some grenade launchers can fire projectiles that inflict status effects on targets that are within its blast radius. For a list of all grenade launchers, see its category page.

Hellas Basin is a region on Mars, located near the planet's southern polar ice caps. It is a destination in Destiny 2: Warmind, and is where Uldren Sov's ship crashed after the Awoken's attack on the Hive Dreadnought failed.

Glaives are a new class of melee weapons that was introduced in the The Witch Queen expansion of Destiny 2. The weapon features a spear-like design and introduced new gameplay mechanics which will allow players to perform powerful melee combos, fire concentrated blasts of projectiles, and deploy a powerful energy shield.

The Hunter is a Guardian class that specializes in mobility, stealth, and marksmanship. Hunters are quick with a blade and quicker on the draw, and are known as the "Masters of the Frontier." Hunters have a well-earned reputation for enjoying spending time out of the wilds, which sometimes gets them into trouble with their commanding officers.

The Hunter Knife is a weapon used by Hunters' melee attacks. Melee attacks by Hunters using this weapon take the form of an upward slashing motion that causes a large amount of damage. Additionally, the Super Ability Arc Blade encases it in electric blue energy, dealing heavy damage. The Hunter Knife is "rugged, utilitarian, and quiet," enabling silent kills for Hunters. Although it has been implied that the Hunter Knife is used exclusively by Hunters, Destiny screenshots have also shown Warlocks using a knife that appears very similar.

Infusion is a process in Destiny that allows the Light of a particular weapon or armor piece to be increased by sacrificing a more powerful item. When an item is infused, it takes on the light level of the item it was infused with. An item can only be infused with another item from the same slot.

Hunger Pangs (Part 1) is a quest in Destiny: The Taken King that must be completed in order to earn the exotic scout rifle Touch of Malice. It is obtained after completing Shattered Past and collecting at least 15 Calcified Fragments. After completing the quest, a Guardian must complete The Old Hunger and collect 30 Calcified Fragments to continue to Hunger Pangs (Part 2).
